summary: SMARTCLOUT iteration 8 (frontend-only) verified on https://teal-node-visual.preview.emergentagent.com. PartnersV2 scatter removed; new vendor-groups DOM with monochromatic-by-default logotypes and hover-driven full-color highlight. ALL 11 acceptance items PASS. 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SPEC vs IMPL nuance on item #6 (individual vendor hover): because .sc-vendor-group carries onMouseEnter={setHoveredCat(cat.id)} in PartnersV2Section.jsx (line 175), hovering ANY child .sc-vendor bubbles up and highlights the WHOLE group (all vendors in the group turn colored, other 5 groups get is-dimmed). Task spec literally read 'reszta grupy pozostaje monochromatyczna' (rest of group stays monochromatic). The current behavior is consistent with rack-slot hover and arguably better UX, but strictly speaking the individual-vendor hover is subsumed by the group-hover. Verified explicitly: hovering [data-testid=vendor-backup-0] -> group has is-highlighted, other 5 groups have is-dimmed, and BOTH backup vendors (0 and 1) show filter=none opacity=1. If the intent was truly per-logo highlight without group side-effects, move onMouseEnter/Leave off .sc-vendor-group onto a wrapping non-listening container OR handle the mouseenter only on the group's __head/__label area.
App.css is now ~3745 lines. Splitting into per-section CSS modules (partners.css, dividers.css, rack.css) is overdue — reiteration from iter 7 report.

The rack-slot button and the vendor-group both call setHoveredCat with the same cat.id and share the same visual highlight/dim CSS. Good: consistent single source of truth for hovered state. Consider extracting the hover-linking into a small custom hook (useHoveredCategory) for reuse if more link-hover UIs are added.

Naming inconsistency persists: PartnersV2Section.jsx uses 'DELL'/'vmware'/'baramundi' while PartnersSection.jsx uses 'Dell'/'VMware'/'Baramundi'. Not a bug (VENDOR_LOGOS maps are separate) but a maintenance risk.

Marquee hover was verifiable only via CSS rule inspection (rule exists: '.sc-partner-card:hover .sc-partner-logo-img { filter: none; opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.03); }') because Playwright hover during the 55s marquee animation is inherently unstable. If reliable hover is needed, consider pausing animation on-hover of the marquee container (already common pattern: animation-play-state: paused on :hover).
